toolInfo.add_text_box: Adds a paragraph text box to a page, for example for text that detection missed. Can be undone. Works without vision, but placement is better when the model can see the page.
toolInfo.delete_elements: Removes text elements and everything inside them. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.delete_pages: Removes pages and everything on them. Undo restores them while Koharu stays open. No vision needed.
toolInfo.draw: Fills one area of a page with a solid color, like the Draw brush, for example white over leftover text. Can be undone. Works without vision, but areas are more accurate when the model can see the page.
toolInfo.erase: Makes one area of a paint or cleanup layer transparent, like the Eraser, for example to bring back a logo that was removed. Can be undone. Works without vision, but areas are more accurate when the model can see the page.
toolInfo.export: Writes PNG, PSD, or CBZ files into a new folder inside the export folder above. Existing files are never replaced, and the project does not change. No vision needed.
toolInfo.inspect_page: Reads one page compactly: its size, every text element with its box, source text, translation, and languages, and its paint and cleanup layers. Agents use it before editing a page. Read-only. No vision needed.
toolInfo.inspect_project: Reads every page of the project as text, without images. Agents use it for an overview; it is large for long projects, so agents should prefer inspect_page. Read-only. No vision needed.
toolInfo.move_element: Moves an element under another parent or to another place in the layer order. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.move_page: Moves a page to another position in the project. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.read_glossary: Reads the project glossary: each term and name with the translation it keeps and an optional note. Changes nothing. No vision needed.
toolInfo.remove: Inpaints one area of a page, like the Remove brush, to clear original text. Given text elements, it removes their detected text whole, as the pipeline does. Only that area changes, and the result goes into the page's cleanup layer. Can be undone. Works without vision, but areas are more accurate when the model can see the page.
toolInfo.rename_page: Changes a page's name in the page list. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.run_pipeline: Runs Koharu's processing pipeline (detection, OCR, translation, inpainting) on the project, some pages, some elements, or one area. Its edits can be undone, and a long run stops when you use Stop now. No vision needed.
toolInfo.set_geometry: Replaces the outline of a text element on the page. Can be undone. Works without vision, but shapes are better when the model can see the page.
toolInfo.set_glossary_terms: Adds terms to the project glossary, or changes the translation or note of terms it has, so later pages and the built-in translation keep them. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.set_page_status: Sets a page's status in the page list: not started, translated by agent, needs review, or done. Agents mark pages they translated or that need your attention. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.set_source_text: Replaces the original-language text of an element, for example to fix an OCR mistake. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.set_translation: Sets or removes one element's translation, tagged with its language so lines break correctly, and warns when the text does not fit. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.set_translations: Sets the translations of many elements in one step; if one element is invalid, nothing changes. One Undo reverts the whole call. Warns when text does not fit. No vision needed.
toolInfo.set_typography: Replaces an element's font, size, colors, outline, alignment, and writing direction. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.set_visibility: Shows, hides, or fades elements. Can be undone. No vision needed.
toolInfo.view_page: Shows the model one page, or one area of it at full size, as an image so it can check placement and leftover text. Read-only. Needs a model that can see images.
